note: Curated editorial roster of the City of Chicago's published bikeway-network commitments, with citations, kept separate from anything OYL measures itself. Delivery is scored against CDOT's own year-by-year figures, recovered under FOIA S145367-071326 and extracted to data/cdot_bikeway_history.json — so both sides of every comparison are the City's own data. The roster spans administrations deliberately: the lens is the bikeway network, not whoever happened to be in office, and a pledge is scored the same way regardless of who made it. Each entry carries a `basis` saying HOW it is scored (network_state, network_delta, or miles_added), the facility `categories` that count, and its window. Where a claim is only reachable under a more generous reading of which facilities count, `alt_categories` records that reading and the ledger publishes both numbers rather than picking one. Only commitments with a direct citation are listed; nothing here is inferred or estimated.

commitments.text: The first 100 miles of protected bike lanes, complete before the end of 2015
commitments.claim_quote: The City is on track to complete the first 100 miles of protected bike lanes before the end of 2015 with more lanes to be completed in 2016.
commitments.alt_note: The claim is only reachable if buffered lanes are counted as protected. CDOT's own dashboard lists them separately and does not count buffered as low-stress (DECISIONS.md #37).
commitments.source_name: City of Chicago, Budget Overview for Year 2016 (O2015-6370), filed with City Council

commitments.text: An additional 50 miles of protected bike lanes by 2019
commitments.claim_quote: By 2019, the City plans to add an additional 50 miles of protected bike lanes.
commitments.alt_note: Shown on the generous reading too; the pledge is missed on either.
commitments.source_name: City of Chicago, Budget Overview for Year 2016 (O2015-6370), filed with City Council

commitments.text: 100 new miles of bike lanes during the mayor's first term (2019-2022)
commitments.claim_quote: Added 45 miles of new bike lanes, surpassing Mayor Lightfoot's goal of 100 new miles in her first term.
commitments.source_name: City of Chicago, Budget Overview for Year 2023 (O2022-3024), filed with City Council
